description: This file contains Python code for checking graph breaks in models, including functions for comparing CSV data, handling flaky models, and updating expected results in a benchmarking context.

methods.name: get_field
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field value for a given model from a CSV DataFrame, returns None if not found or error occurs.

methods.name: check_graph_breaks
methods.description: Compares actual and expected CSV data for models' graph breaks, updates flaky models list, and generates a report message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, reads CSV files, and executes the graph break check, exiting with status 1 if failures are found.
